snapshot.name: Git Team Workflow Best Practices
snapshot.description: Enforce Git team workflow best practices when collaborating on code repositories. Covers branching strategies, commit message conventions, atomic commits, rebasing, pull requests, tagging, and CI checks. Use this skill to ensure consistent, high-quality version control in team environments.
snapshot.instructions:
When working with Git in a team:
1. Always create feature branches from main/develop
2. Write clear commit messages: type(scope): description
3. Keep commits atomic - one logical change per commit
4. Rebase feature branches before merging to keep linear history
5. Use pull requests for code review before merging
6. Never force push to shared branches
7. Tag releases with semantic versioning (v1.2.3)
8. Use .gitignore to exclude build artifacts and secrets
9. Squash fixup commits before merge
10. Run CI checks before merging any PR
